# S41 — Overview engine-row edge cases: setup projects, padding, hidden ledger runs

From the S22 review. (1) A setup project with no .slicer/ and an engine run counts the wait in the badge but shows no rows. (2) Engine rows under Running are not padded to the kind width, so they can misalign beside an unlinked started-elsewhere row. (3) A ledger run linked to a committed or superseded engine run is hidden by design, but no test or doc says so.

## Why

From the S22 review. (1) A setup project with no .slicer/ and an engine run counts the wait in the badge but shows no rows. (2) Engine rows under Running are not padded to the kind width, so they can misalign beside an unlinked started-elsewhere row. (3) A ledger run linked to a committed or superseded engine run is hidden by design, but no test or doc says so.
